name: 98 Token swap contract's public swapTokensForTokens spends its own balance
summary: The 98 swap contract 0xb040d88e exposed swapTokensForTokens(address[],uint256,uint256,address) to anyone; it swaps the contract's own 98 holding and sends the proceeds to the caller's recipient. A day after deployment the attacker swapped its entire 97.6B 98 into the 98/USDT pair for 27,995 USDT.
notes: The swap contract's 98 is valued at what its sale realised (rule 12): the pair's USDT outflow.
